global: There is exactly one light-wood rectangular block, kept as the same tracked object with unchanged rigid rectangular geometry, light-wood appearance, and single intact identity. There is exactly one wooden ramp, kept as the same tracked object with unchanged fixed ramp geometry, wooden appearance, and stationary identity. There is exactly one broad rough gray floor, kept as the same tracked object with unchanged flat fixed geometry, rough gray appearance, and stationary identity.

stages.text: The block starts on the upper ramp and gravity already pulls it down the rightward slope. The ramp and rough floor remain fixed. The light-wood rectangular block is visible as exactly one instance, sliding right down the upper ramp. For the light-wood rectangular block, this stage changes only position along ramp and sliding speed. The block stays supported by the ramp surface.

The light-wood rectangular block stays continuously visible through the transition as exactly one instance, crossing continuously from the ramp end onto the rough floor. For the light-wood rectangular block, this stage changes only position and sliding speed. The same block makes one support transition without jumping or duplicating.

The light-wood rectangular block is visible as exactly one instance, sliding right across the rough floor with decreasing speed. For the light-wood rectangular block, this stage changes only horizontal position and sliding speed. Successive horizontal displacements become smaller under friction.

The light-wood rectangular block is visible as exactly one instance, losing its remaining speed and stopping right of the ramp. For the light-wood rectangular block, this stage changes only horizontal position and sliding speed. The block remains supported by the floor.
The light-wood rectangular block is visible as exactly one instance, intact and motionless on the rough floor. Exactly one unchanged block remains to the right of the fixed ramp.
